title: Permanent Microsoft Entra role assignment outside PIM
description: Detects a successful permanent Microsoft Entra role assignment made outside Privileged Identity Management.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may establish durable privileged access by assigning a permanent Microsoft Entra role outside PIM.
hypothesis.rationale: A permanent role assignment bypasses just-in-time activation controls, but emergency access, migration, and approved administration can produce the same audit operation.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful permanent role assignments outside PIM while leaving failures, eligible assignments, removals, and incomplete events unmatched.

triage.summary: Validate the initiator, assigned principal, role, assignment scope, and change authorization before treating the permanent assignment as malicious.
steps: Identify the initiating identity, target principal, assigned role, directory scope, and assignment timestamp from the audit record.
Confirm whether an approved emergency-access, migration, or administrative change required a permanent assignment outside PIM.
Review adjacent role and credential changes, then remove unauthorized access and investigate the initiating identity.
Treat this as change or policy monitoring; correlate with actor risk and an approved change record before opening an incident.
false_positives: Approved emergency-access accounts, migrations, break-glass procedures, and administrative changes

validation.expected_outcome: Match only successful permanent role assignments outside PIM; do not match failures, eligible assignments, removals, or missing results.

limitations: Authorized administration can produce this event. The rule does not independently establish compromise or completion of a command; assess identity, target and change approval.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
